analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (73,770 KRW) vs SMA5 (77,558 KRW) / SMA20 (84,262 KRW) / SMA50 (95,073 KRW): Below short- to mid-term trends, confirming weak positioning.
· Significant decline below SMA100 (102,212 KRW) / SMA200 (101,589 KRW): Weakening long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (35.3%) + approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.8→31.8): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-19.1982→-290.3986): Worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 71,892 KRW): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (72,105 KRW): Based on 5-day/20-day low patterns, testing support level.
· Swing resistance (86,835 KRW): Potential for short-term rebound attempt if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: Higher Low unconfirmed, potential Lower High, sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.39x): Increased, but insufficient to signal a trend reversal; increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Considering potential for further decline due to oversold RSI and worsening MACD, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
